verdict.rationale: Unreal's official Neural Network Engine (NNE) gives a common API over multiple neural-network runtimes, explicitly for real-time inference inside a game, so the core story is an official first-party capability. NNE is marked Beta ('use caution when shipping with it'), and the evidence is a single overview snippet. Missing for 10: production-ready (non-Beta) status, documentation of supported model formats, runtime backends and target platforms (CPU/GPU, mobile, console), and independent or hands-on corroboration of shipped in-game inference.
